gꜣḥ: gꜣḥ — to be weary, faint (?) (verb; Budge: ḳeḥ, 'be needy')
hꜣ-ḫrw: hꜣ-ḫrw — Ha-kheru, perhaps 'Descending of voice' (?), the announcer of the first gate of Spell 147 (name of a gatekeeper demon; from hꜣ 'go down' and ḫrw 'voice'; meaning doubtful; Budge: Ha-χeru)
mtty-ḥ: mtty-ḥ — Metety-he (?), the watcher of the first gate of Spell 147; the name is not understood (name of a gatekeeper demon; reading of the last sign uncertain; Budge: Metti-heh)
mꜣꜥtyw: mꜣꜥtyw — the gods of Maat (?), beings named from mꜣꜥt 'right order' (noun pl., with the god classifier; reading and meaning a guess; Budge: Maāta, 'the Maāta gods')
qbb: qbb — cool water, the deep (?) (noun; reading doubtful; Budge: ḳeb, 'the great deep')
qq-ḥwꜣwt-nt-pḥwy: qq-ḥwꜣwt-nt-pḥwy — Qeq-huaut-net-pehuy, 'Eater of the rot of the hindquarters', the doorkeeper of the third gate of Spell 147 (name of a gatekeeper demon; from qq 'eat', ḥwꜣwt 'putrefaction', nt 'of', pḥwy 'hinder parts'; Budge: Qeq-ḥauatu-ent-peḥui)
rnpt: rnpt — year (noun f.; plural rnpwt 'years'; written with the palm-rib; Budge: renput)
rḏw: rḏw — efflux, exudation, the fluids that run from a corpse (noun; Budge: ertu, 'foul emanations')
smnḫ: smnḫ — to make excellent, set in order, endow (verb; causative of mnḫ 'be excellent'; Budge: semenχ)
snḏm: snḏm — to ease, soothe, make pleasant (verb; causative of nḏm 'be sweet, pleasant'; Budge: senet'em)
spr: spr — to arrive, reach (verb; spr r 'arrive at'; Budge: sper)
sqd-ḥr: sqd-ḥr — Seqed-her, perhaps 'Voyaging of face' (?), the watcher of the second gate of Spell 147 (name of a gatekeeper demon; from sqdi 'travel by boat' and ḥr 'face'; a guess; Budge: Seqeṭ-ḥrà)
srs-ḥr: srs-ḥr — Seres-her, 'Watchful of face' (?), the watcher of the third gate of Spell 147 (name of a gatekeeper demon; from srs 'awaken, make watchful', the causative of rs 'wake', and ḥr 'face'; the reading rests on an uncertain sign; Budge: Se-res-ḥrà)
sḫd-ḥr-ꜥšꜣ-irw: sḫd-ḥr-ꜥšꜣ-irw — Sekhed-her-asha-iru, perhaps 'Upside-down of face, many of forms' (?), the doorkeeper of the first gate of Spell 147 (name of a gatekeeper demon; from sḫd 'be upside down', ḥr 'face', ꜥšꜣ 'many', irw 'forms'; the first half doubtful; Budge: Seχeṭ-ḥrà-āśt-àru)
sḫḫ: sḫḫ — meaning unknown (a word not identified; Budge: seχeχ, 'made to balance')
sṯꜣ: sṯꜣ — to drag, draw along, tow (verb; often written stꜣ; Budge: sta, 'lead on')
wn-ḥꜣt: wn-ḥꜣt — Wen-hat, perhaps 'Open of front' (?), the doorkeeper of the second gate of Spell 147 (name of a gatekeeper demon; from wn 'open' and ḥꜣt 'front, brow'; how the two join is not clear; Budge: Un-ḥāt)
wsd: wsd — Used (?), the announcer of the second gate of Spell 147; the name is not understood (name of a gatekeeper demon; its classifiers point to cutting or force; Budge: Useṭ)
ḏꜥbt: ḏꜥbt — charcoal, burning coals (noun f.; Budge: t'ābet)
ḫmt: ḫmt — to think, intend, plan (verb); thought, intention (noun) (Budge: χemet, 'desire')
ḫmtnw: ḫmtnw — third (ordinal numeral, from ḫmt 'three'; feminine ḫmtnwt; Budge: χemt)

__broaden__.ꜥryt: ꜥryt — door-frame, entrance; a part of the doorway, perhaps the lintel or a jamb (noun; Budge: ārit) · gate, gateway, gatehouse, one of the gates of the realm of Osiris (noun f.; with the house sign as classifier; Budge: ārit, 'hall')
__broaden__.smi: smi — to report, announce, make known; to accuse (smi r 'report against'); to make petition (verb; infinitive smit); report, petition (noun) · announcer, herald, the being who reports whoever arrives (noun; Budge: semà)
__broaden__.sḫn: sḫn — to stir up, provoke · to embrace (verb; with the embracing arms as classifier; Budge: seχen)
__broaden__.imi: imi — give! (imperative of rdi 'give') · also cause, let (before a sḏm·f: imi wn·i 'let me be'; with a passive, imi di·tw 'cause that there be given') · a second word of the same spelling: the negative verb 'do not', 'you are not to' (imi with a suffix and the negatival complement of the next verb: im·k sḏm 'you shall not hear')
__broaden__.wnḫ: wnḫ — to put on, clothe oneself in (verb; of garments) · to clothe, dress a person, a god's image or a standard (verb, transitive)
